title: bootstrap failed to build on Centos (devtoolset-7, 8)

labels.name: category:vcpkg-bug
labels.description: The issue is with the vcpkg system (including helper scripts in `scripts/cmake/`)

body:
**Describe the bug**
after commit :
e62d13612 ("[vcpkg] Add Supports: field. Use contents of triplets instead of names for dependency resolution. (#8601)", 2020-02-03)

**Environment**
- OS: Centos 7
- Compiler: Gcc 7, gcc 8 (devtoolset-7, devtoolset-8)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. ./bootstrap-vcpkg.sh
2. See error below, example is for devtoolset-8 (gcc8.3.1), same happens with devtoolset-7(gcc7xx). Interestingly, it does work on ubuntu1804 with the builtin gcc 8.3.0

**Expected behavior**
should build vcpkg
**Failure logs**
